run_SimpleGridSearcher: create a SimpleGridSearcher instance, define grid parameters, and run grid search experiments with a launcher
define_grid_param: define grid search parameters with parameter names and their possible values for experiment combinations
run_grid_search: launch all parameter combination experiments by calling grid_search on a configured SimpleGridSearcher instance
get_all_explorer_sigs: extract experiment signature strings from an explorer method by patching a launcher and collecting XP folder names
get_dummy_version: generate a unique version string from the calling grid file name and a version number for experiment flags
